title: Democracy as a normative theory, not a percentage of countries
summary: Christiano and Bajaj separate the moral theory of democracy from the empirical study of institutions.
body: Tom Christiano and Sameer Bajaj's Stanford Encyclopedia entry distinguishes normative democratic theory (when and why democracy is morally desirable) from empirical theories of how institutions work. The v1 article mixes Athenian history, modern representation, a "~45 percent of countries" figure, and a warning about backsliding. The percentage was not on the Freedom House page text we could read, which did not yield a count. Leave the percentage unsourced. Athens's exclusions (women, enslaved people, foreigners) are part of any honest account and were not re-read from Aristotle in this pass, so they stay on the unsourced Greece card rather than being asserted from memory.
